examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: List stack contents in a fixed bottom-to-top convention after each operation. Postfix evaluation pops the right operand before the left; subtraction and division are order-sensitive. For constrained output permutations, track capacity and whether output is allowed from a stack, another stack, or a queue.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
Evaluate postfix expression 8 3 2 * − 4 +.

**Answer: 6.** Push 8,3,2; multiply 3·2 to get 6. Subtract using 8−6=2, not 6−8. Push 4 and add to obtain 6.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
An auxiliary prefix-minimum pointer per record supports O(1) MIN. One global minimum pointer alone cannot recover the earlier minimum after a pop.

Popping two operands in the wrong order changes subtraction and division.
